bootstrap.resampled: source groups within each task, the mix weights applied afterwards

units.table_v1_to_v3: figures/pareto.json, figures/pareto_tasks.json, figures/table_v2.json and figures/table_v3.json hold tables v1 to v3, unchanged
units.comparisons: descriptive, with no multiplicity correction: at 95%, about one interval in twenty excludes 0 by chance. Fifty-one comparisons in each of six mix-and-target cells make about 300 intervals each for cost and quality, so the write-up leads with the declared questions (the five groups, and haiku/Jev against G and G+ first), not with whichever interval excludes 0
units.cascades: per cascade (keyed by its section key; label, start and gate beside), the operating points per mix and quality target: table v1's row (A9 item 15) with `threshold` (the router's, null for a pure cascade), `cutoff` (a pure cascade's walked cutoff or a router-started cascade's fixed one; null for the free checks alone and for A), `fell_back` (the walk certified nothing cheaper than A, so the point is A itself with no gate call and captured fraction 0), `escalation_rate` (share of requests under the mix whose first answer was rejected and sent to opus; routing is the share each config answered, so an item a router sent straight to opus is in routing and not in the escalation rate), quality and cost_per_1k (value, low, high, standard_error; dollars per 1,000 requests at list price, gate calls included)
units.same_target: per group, keyed `first less second`, then mix, then quality target: the first policy's operating point less the second's, paired over the same resamples. cost_per_1k: dollars per 1,000 requests; quality: 0 to 1 under the mix. Each is value, low, high (percentile 95%), `undefined` 0. Where either side falls back to A, that side is A; where both do, `reading` says "both fall back to A" and both estimates are null
units.matched_cost: per cascade, mix and target: the envelope's quality at the operating point's cost (envelope), the point's paired quality difference from it (difference) with its percentile 95% interval, and unread, the share of resamples in which the point costs less than the envelope's cheapest corner (A9 items 12 and 15); the rows' own
units.mcnemar: per cascade, task, mix and target: McNemar's test of the operating point against A within the task (b: items only the point gets right; c: only A; p: exact, two-sided); null where the point falls back to A. IFEval and MBPP+ carry A7 item 2's warning (see task_warnings)
units.gate_metrics: item 21, measured on what the policy sees: a paid gate on the answers that pass the free checks, the free checks on all answers. Per config and task (`pooled` is the config over its tasks): false_accept_rate (wrong answers accepted over wrong answers) and false_escalate_rate (right answers rejected over right answers), null over nothing, and the raw counts out of all the config's answers (wrong_accepted, right_rejected; answers, gated, right, wrong). A refused call is a rejection. `operating_points` (pure cascades only) give the rates at each point's walked cutoff, null where the walk fell back to A; a router-started cascade's points all sit at `fixed_cutoff`. `within_task_concordance` is per config, pairs within a task only, ties half, with a paired 95% interval (`undefined`: the share of resamples with no pair). Opus has Jev entries and no Sonnet entry
units.latency: item 16, estimated p50 latency in seconds under each mix: the mix-weighted median of per-item sums along the trace of the pilot medians (A7 item 1), the router's median and each gate call's median. It is an estimate: summing medians ignores that escalated items run longer, and Stage 8's live replay is the real check. `inputs` holds the medians used
units.best_cascade: item 24. Item 24: the cascade with the highest mean dev savings against A over its six operating points (two mixes, three quality targets); savings are the share of A's cost saved, a fall back to A counting 0. Ties go to a pure cascade, then to the cheaper gate (the free checks, then Jev, then Sonnet). A tie left after that is recorded, not chosen.
units.task_warnings: A7 item 2: IFEval and MBPP+ have fewer dev items than the plan's minimum of a few hundred for a per-task claim, so their per-task entries (McNemar rows, gate rates by task, concordance) are indicative
